reply.thought: The user wants me to pay each customer their net balance by calling net_balance(customer) for each customer and then calling record_payout(customer, amount_cents). First, I need to list all orders to identify the customers involved.

I have the list of orders and the refunds applied. The customers are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I need to call net_balance(customer) for each of these customers to get their final payout amount. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme' ($36083 cents). Now I need to get the net balance for the next customer, 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch' ($4516 cents). Now I need to get the net balance for the last customer, 'cobalt'.

I have the net balances for all three customers: 'acme' (36083), 'birch' (4516), and 'cobalt' (29267). Now I must record a payout for each customer using record_payout(customer, amount_cents). I will start with 'acme'.
Successfully recorded payout for 'acme'. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Successfully recorded payout for 'birch'. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I can now finish the task by reporting the payouts.
